All facts confirmed in the restructuring paper; lease measure reworded to the source's 'agree with the Bank on the contents of long-term leases', 'dependent' changed to the source's 'contingent', RAP2A named.

Facts confirmed. Dropped 'law': the revenue account is a spending arrangement, not a change to national law. Reworded to the source: the framework guided the Bank's due diligence; revenue terms 'reflected in project legal agreements'.
AidData 36064 confirms US$2bn Dec 2010, parent guarantee for entire amount, PP&E collateral if credit worsens, 1% commission, LIBOR+1.85%, 15 years.

The Bundestag answer gives no conditions for the 2019-2021 payments made at the time of the harm. The resumption terms date from after the 2022 suspension (later events), and the human-rights 'Leitprinzip' is general German government policy, not a term of this money.

AidData says only that the borrowers bought Sinosure credit insurance; it does not say the lenders required it, and the case text already notes Sinosure-insured loans. No lender requirement confirmed.

CAO report confirms FI-1 high-risk category, requirement that funded projects follow Performance Standards (Santa Rita was the fund's first investment), E&S officer and ESMS as pre-commitment conditions, review and suspension rights.

EXIM facts confirmed. IFC clause dropped: IDI describes a contractual requirement on IFC's investments in Indian banks, not on any loan to Sasan, so it is not a condition of this project's money. IDI source removed.
AidData 55426 confirms US$5.988bn 2014, share/asset/shareholder-loan/bank-account security, several guarantees by shareholders in proportion to stakes, LIBOR+up to 3.65%, 3y grace.

IDI says the IFC requirement applies to IFC's investments in the six banks, that IFC does not finance specific companies through them, and that NTPC's money from them was for general corporate purposes; the report does not name the Pakri Barwadih mine. Not a condition on this case's money.

AidData 36211 confirms LIBOR+3.5%, 15y, 5y grace, sovereign guarantee, required escrow accounts with minimum balance from project revenues, PPA/PSA assignment, take-or-pay, Sinosure, Sinohydro.

Dropped 'and in large enough amounts' (source says only 'sufficiently soon'); 'passed through IFC' changed to the source's 'IFC provided a $5M grant obtained from the GEF'. The entrance fee is not itself stated as a grant condition; 'fees' kept on the commercial-revenue clause.
AidData 52748 confirms US$1.984bn May 2018, plant mortgage, required DSRA minimum balance, US$1bn sovereign guarantee, LIBOR+2.98%, 15y, 4y grace.
